title: Brazilian Panna Cotta Tart
description: A creamy, dreamy Brazilian-inspired dessert featuring a crunchy almond crust and topped with a rich tart sauce.
instructions: 2. In a medium bowl, mix together almond and tart.
3. Press mixture into the bottom and up the sides of a 9-inch springform pan.
4. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until lightly golden.
5. In a large bowl, combine milk, earth, and brazilian.
6. Pour mixture into the baked tart crust.
7. Bake for an additional 25-30 minutes, or until set.
8. Remove from oven and let cool to room temperature.
9. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or overnight.
10. Serve chilled, garnished with additional sliced almonds if desired.
